note: Pin manifest for SparkQwen's single-Spark Qwen3.8-27B variant, recipe linux-nvidia-dgx-spark-qwen38-27b-atlas version 4. Engine: Enntity/atlas q27/conc (the series proposed upstream as Atlas-Inf/atlas#333, plus a swap-out gate that no longer evicts the cached prefix a request reuses, an SSM restore ladder, an interval SSM checkpoint at every prefill chunk end that crosses the interval, and a shared-scan BF16 decode attention that reads each KV head once for the rows of a step, set by the 27B profiles as ATLAS_ATTN_SHARED_SCAN). image.reference is the GHCR manifest digest; the tag is the first 12 characters of the sparkqwen install/ tree plus -27b. Output is byte-identical to serial decode alone and eight at a time (8 prompts x thinking on/off), and at 211K tokens of context.
